# PiTTy 1.2.9

## Tool-result image previews

- Stop displaying JPEG, PNG, WebP, and GIF image payloads as Base64 text.
- Preserve text and bounded image attachments separately for live tool results, resumed sessions, and subagent transcripts. The original session files and tool data remain unchanged.
- Show compact inline image previews. `details` enlarges the image and reveals additional images without flooding the transcript.
- Use OpenTUI's native image rendering with automatic protocol selection: Kitty graphics where available, Sixel when supported, or Unicode colored blocks as a compatible fallback.
- Continue showing meaningful text descriptions and errors alongside the image. Corrupt, unsupported, oversized, or mismatched images fail closed without printing encoded data.
- Keep image payloads bounded to four images per tool, at most 8 MiB of Base64 per image, and limit dimensions/pixels before native decoding.

Tests cover live and restored images, error handling, multi-image rows, terminal protocol fallback, and preview expansion. A real 900×2000 JPEG from a saved PiTTy session was also rendered in the headless terminal UI.

The release does not modify terminal/tmux settings, credentials, the Pi runtime, saved conversations, or running agents. A staged update activates on the next launch.
